name: universal-ai-video-production
description: A guided AI video production workflow with ten coordinated skills for ideation, writing, design, production, and review.

interface.shortDescription: One guided workflow with ten AI video production skills.
interface.longDescription: Guides creators from early visual ideas through screenplay, worldbuilding, character and scene design, storyboards, generation requests, video production, and evidence-based review.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn a rough visual idea into an AI short film, one small decision at a time.
我只有一个模糊的短片想法，请从一个容易比较的小目标开始。
막연한 영상 아이디어가 있습니다. 한 번에 작은 목표 하나씩 진행해 주세요.
